commands:
cat >/tmp/run_aer.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export RCLONE_CONFIG=/etc/rclone.conf
cd /opt/aer-scraper/WebScraping/linux
PART=$(cat /etc/aer/part || echo 00)
python3.11 scrape_and_push.py wells_parts/wells_${PART}.txt --bucket aer-scrape-prod --remote s3aer --prefix Data --out-base /data/Data --workers 2 --dashboards Well_Summary_Report --headless
EOF
